title: Finding
description: A structured finding record produced by the Breaker or Reviewer agent. Every finding must have a stable ID, category, severity, confidence, and status.

id.description: Stable, unique finding identifier. Example: BRK-001, REV-003.

title.description: Concise, specific description of the finding.

severity.description: Impact severity if the finding is real.

confidence.description: Strength of evidence that the finding is valid.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the finding.

summary.description: Short, plain-language summary of the issue.

requirement_refs.description: References to approved specification requirements or acceptance criteria affected.

affected_files.description: Relative paths to affected source files.

evidence.description: Command output, test results, log excerpts, or code references supporting the finding. Redact secrets.

reproduction_steps.description: Step-by-step instructions to reproduce the finding, including preconditions.

expected_behavior.description: What should happen according to approved specifications or accepted behavior.

impact.description: Consequence to users, data, security, or system stability if the finding is real.

recommended_action.description: Suggested next step: fix, defer, investigate, accept, or reject.

code_identity.description: Repository state at the time the finding was recorded.

authorization.description: User authorization record. Only set when the Controller confirms explicit user authorization.

verification.description: Independent re-verification result after a fix is applied.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this finding was first recorded.
